npc.title: Dialog
npc.name: Kevin.exe
lines: Hey, traveler! I'm Kevin, or at least the version of him that runs in this arcade.
I study Software Engineering at UMC and have been working since I was 17.
Today I'm an apprentice in a school's office. There I built PDF Renamer and SEK, which the team uses every day.
I started coding at 15 with OneBitCode's courses. Never stopped.
My current quest: an internship. If you have an opening, the boss over at contact is waiting.
NPC tip: there are coins hidden around the site. Collect them all and something special shows up in the inventory.
